1.web: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
1.asv: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling-place In all generations.

2.web: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
2.asv: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

3.web: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
3.asv: Thou turnest man to destruction, And sayest, Return, ye children of men.

4.web: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
4.asv: For a thousand years in thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.

5.web: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
5.asv: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

6.web: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
6.asv: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

7.web: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
7.asv: For we are consumed in thine anger, And in thy wrath are we troubled.

8.web: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
8.asv: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

9.web: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
9.asv: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

10.web: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
10.asv: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but labor and sorrow; For it is soon gone, and we fly away.

11.web: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
11.asv: Who knoweth the power of thine anger, And thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto thee?

12.web: So teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
12.asv: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.

13.web: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
13.asv: Return, O Jehovah; how long? And let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

14.web: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
14.asv: Oh satisfy us in the morning with thy lovingkindness, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

15.web: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
15.asv: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, And the years wherein we have seen evil.

16.web: Let your work appear to your servants; your glory to their children.
16.asv: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, And thy glory upon their children.

17.web: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us; establish the work of our hands for us; yes, establish the work of our hands.
17.asv: And let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us; And establish thou the work of our hands upon us; Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
